newsitem.title: USA: Cubist says in Pfizer licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: Cubist says in Pfizer licensing pact.

text.p: Cubist Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday it has signed a license agreement with Pfizer Inc after an initial screening agreement with the company had expired.
Cubist said the rights to a selected lead compound discovered during the screening period are now covered by the license and it does not expect any further financing from Pfizer.

Cubist said the two companies entered into an 18-month agreement in December 1995 to screen the Pfizer compound library against certain aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase targets and to conduct secondary screens on certain of the leads.

Cubist is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the research, development and commercialization of anti-infective drugs to treat infectious diseases caused by drug resistant bacteria and fungi. The company went public in October.
